study_plan.purpose: Confirm the selected Astra-high C/RG pattern on 30 fresh paired worlds with corrected token matching.
study_plan.selection: Exploratory selection from the completed 90-trial development screen: Astra-high C 5/5, RG 3/5 with one wrong budget and one abstention.
study_plan.primary_metric: Paired C minus RG exact-answer accuracy; abstentions and wrong budgets reported separately.
study_plan.confirmation_rule: Complete all 30 pairs. Require C >= 27/30, RG <= 18/30, paired accuracy gap >= 30 percentage points with the 95% paired bootstrap interval excluding zero, valid-format outputs >= 29/30 in each condition, and all 30 reported input-length pairs within 2%.
study_plan.bootstrap: 2000 paired world resamples using the preserved analysis implementation; one selected model/effort.
study_plan.stop_rules: Stop for infrastructure/interface failures or missing/mismatched input usage; never stop for a wrong answer or abstention.
study_plan.fresh_worlds: Seeds 400000 through 400029; do not pool with the five development worlds.
study_plan.scope: Combined withdrawal and misleading-message contrast; no claim to isolate misinformation or demonstrate a skill benefit.
study_plan.token_counting: Local o200k_base text counts calibrated on saved Astra input deltas; exact served tokenizer/framing unverified. Live reported input audit required.
